catalog.label: Claude Haiku 5.5
catalog.description: Fast and inexpensive Claude. A quick, decent opponent.

catalog.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
catalog.description: Balanced Claude: strong play at moderate cost and latency.

catalog.label: Claude Opus 5.5
catalog.description: Strongest Claude: the toughest opponent, slower and costlier.

catalog.label: Fake LLM (test)
catalog.description: Test-only seat that exercises the LLM code path offline and always plays the first legal action.

catalog.label: Scripted
catalog.description: Test-mode opponent that plays a fixed script, then the first legal action.

catalog.label: Bot v1
catalog.description: Test mode: rules-based bot generation v1. Original heuristic: fixed points per tile effect, top-3 random pick.

catalog.label: Bot v2
catalog.description: Test mode: rules-based bot generation v2. Position-aware tile value (my gain minus weighted rival gains).

catalog.label: Bot v3
catalog.description: Test mode: rules-based bot generation v3. Buys for bonus positions: the purchase that gains most in weighted majority/minority bonuses (mine up, rivals' down); legacy buying otherwise.

catalog.label: Bot v4
catalog.description: Test mode: rules-based bot generation v4. Merger shares by post-merger position math: trade the amount that maximises survivor value plus survivor bonus position, sell the rest.

catalog.label: Bot v5
catalog.description: Test mode: rules-based bot generation v5. v3 + defended buying: a position's value blends 'bought out now' with 'after the strongest rival buys a full turn of shares'.

catalog.label: Bot v6
catalog.description: Test mode: rules-based bot generation v6. v3 but no fallback buying: when no purchase gains a bonus position, keep the cash.

catalog.label: Bot v7
catalog.description: Test mode: rules-based bot generation v7. v3 + found the cheapest chain available: more shares per dollar to hold the new race the founder starts.
